messages:
incident-bot: :pager: PagerDuty alert PD-8921 triggered — heartbeat anomaly detected in us-west & us-east. severity: P3. Auto-resolve in 2m if signal subsides.

jordan: ack

alex (oncall): seeing same in grafana, short spike across proxy canaries. latency looks stable, no 5xx increase. no customer-facing errors yet.

maria: confirmed — synthetic canary pings spiked at ~15:02. pattern looks like duplicated scheduler runs.

sam: could be the cron overlap from yesterday's deploy. i'll check scheduler logs.

alex (oncall): logs excerpt: 
```
2026-03-17T15:02:08Z monitor: canary ping queued (attempt 1) region=us-west
2026-03-17T15:02:09Z monitor: canary ping 200 OK region=us-west latency=2ms
2026-03-17T15:02:09Z monitor: canary ping queued (attempt 1) region=us-east
```

oncall-bot: PD-8921 acknowledged by jordan

jordan: i'll watch for 5m, will escalate if we see error rate or customer impact.

maria: checked Sentry/support — nothing unusual. ticket queue normal. looks isolated to synthetic checks.

sam: lowering synthetic scheduler concurrency by 50% on staging now to validate.

alex (oncall): good. plan: wait for auto-resolve, then follow up with sched owners and add backoff. @infra-team fyi. :eyes:

maria: noted — no product telemetry affected. only canary metrics.

jordan: auto-resolve fired at 1765054380, alert closed automatically. leaving thread pinned for 10m for follow-up.

oncall-bot: PD-8921 auto-resolved (duration 58s)

sam: filing follow-up: reduce synthetic burstiness and add jitter. will propose threshold changes to avoid 1m blips causing pages.

alex (oncall): thanks. if it comes back we escalate. otherwise capture post-incident actions and tune alerts.

maria: action items: 1) increase canary backoff, 2) add rate-limiter to scheduler job, 3) tune alert to ignore single 1m blips. assigning to @sam and @infra-team.

jordan: acked. no customer impact observed. closing unless recurrence. :white_check_mark:
